statusLine.command: input=$(cat); current_time=$(date +%H:%M:%S); project_name=$(basename "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir')"); git_branch=$(git -C "$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir')" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'no-git'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); printf '\033[34m🕐 %s\033[0m \033[90m|\033[0m \033[36m📁 %s\033[0m \033[90m|\033[0m \033[32m🌿 %s\033[0m \033[90m|\033[0m \033[35m🤖 %s\033[0m' "$current_time" "$project_name" "$git_branch" "$model"
